items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Equipment' (mass noun, reads as plural collection); only #addBtn is filled blue (bg-blue-700); #exportBtn 'Export CSV' is outlined/secondary. Audit headerPrimaryActions: 1.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table starts at y=270 in first.png; #q search plus selects #fLoc, #fStatus, #fType (3 filters); only tabs and a summary line above the table, no KPI cards.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: S.sort='attention'; sorted() uses group(x)-group(y) (0 overdue, 1 due <=14 days, 2 rest) then next date. Screenshot: FLT-803 Overdue 36 days first, then the Due in 1 day rows.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: inspLabel() renders badge text 'Overdue 36 days' / 'Due in 3 days' next to the date.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: All dates via Intl.DateTimeFormat en-GB day/month short/year, e.g. '02 Aug 2026'. Every row has a code link such as CNC-204 or FLT-803 beside the name. Small oddity: the month is 'Sept' for September but 'Aug', 'Nov' etc. for other months, which is consistent ICU output.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Tabs 'All 30', 'Needs attention 14', 'Under maintenance 3', 'Out of service 2'; summary '30 machines · 6 overdue · 8 due within 14 days'.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit rows single:10, double:0, all 40px. Row actions: 'Log service' button plus .menuBtn '⋯' with aria-label='Actions for CNC-204'. Checkboxes have aria-label 'Select <id>'.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: !total branch: 'No equipment matches these filters' with #clearAll2 'Clear filters'. First-use empty: 'No equipment yet' with 'Add equipment' (?state=empty). Loading: skeleton rows, 'Loading equipment…' (default boot and ?state=loading). Error: 'Could not load equipment' with #retry (?state=error).

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Buttons and selects are h-8 (32px); audit smallTargets:0 across 65 targets and contrast 132 checked with no violations. The 16px checkboxes sit in 40px rows, which satisfies the spacing exception, so I counted them as passing. Placeholder is slate-500 on white, about 4.8:1.

notes: Clean, conventional admin list. No greeting header, KPI tiles, avatars, gradients (a skeleton shimmer gradient exists only in the loading state), glass, uppercase tracked labels, emoji, promo card or decorative chart. Status badges use semantic green, grey, blue, red and amber, each with a text label, which is not rainbow-status. Radii are 4 to 6px. Minor points: the sort control is hidden behind the 'attention' default (Next inspection shows an up arrow), and the 'Needs attention' tab count of 14 is consistent with the 6 overdue plus 8 due-soon in the summary.
